name: Python Code Review
description: Review Python files for coding standards and best practices.
prompt: Review the recently saved Python file. Check for PEP 8 compliance, FastAPI best practices, async programming, type hints, exception handling, Pydantic validation, Beanie ODM usage, code readability, and maintainability. Suggest improvements without changing the overall functionality.

name: API Review
description: Validate FastAPI endpoints and API design.
prompt: Review this FastAPI API implementation. Verify endpoint naming, request and response models, HTTP status codes, validation, exception handling, route consistency, and REST API best practices.

name: Unit Test Review
description: Review unit tests for completeness and coverage.
prompt: Review the recently saved test file. Identify missing edge cases, validation scenarios, mocking improvements, assertion quality, and opportunities to improve test coverage.

name: Backend Code Review
description: Review Python backend files for architecture, coding standards, and maintainability.
prompt: Review the recently saved Python file. Verify FastAPI best practices, async programming, service-layer architecture, Beanie ODM usage, Pydantic validation, exception handling, naming conventions, code readability, and maintainability. Suggest improvements without changing functionality.

name: API Review
prompt: Review this API implementation. Verify REST conventions, endpoint naming, request and response schemas, status codes, dependency injection, validation, exception handling, and consistency with existing APIs.

name: Service Layer Review
description: Ensure business logic remains inside services.
prompt: Review the service implementation. Verify business logic, separation of concerns, async operations, database interactions, reusable methods, error handling, and code quality.

name: Database Model Review
description: Review Beanie models and Pydantic schemas.
prompt: Review the database model or schema. Verify field definitions, validation, indexes, naming conventions, default values, relationships, and adherence to Beanie and Pydantic best practices.

name: Frontend Review
prompt: Review the React implementation. Verify component reusability, state management, API usage, Material UI consistency, accessibility, responsive design, and maintainability.

name: Unit Test Review
prompt: Review the test implementation. Identify missing edge cases, validation scenarios, mocking improvements, assertion quality, and opportunities to improve test coverage.

name: Documentation Review
prompt: Review the documentation. Ensure it matches the implementation, follows project terminology, and includes any newly introduced functionality or architectural changes.
